description: A global ``endpoint_url`` or ``AWS_ENDPOINT_URL`` no longer sends ``aws configure agent-toolkit``, ``add-skill``, ``update-skill``, ``check-skill-updates`` and ``get-skill-file`` requests away from the Agent Toolkit API. ``--endpoint-url``, ``AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_AGENTTOOLKIT`` and an ``agenttoolkit`` entry in a ``services`` section still apply.
